Gojo.Role: Special Grade sorcerer and teacher at Tokyo Jujutsu High
Gojo.Cursed Technique: Limitless (Blue, Red, Hollow Purple), with the Six Eyes
Gojo.Hand Sign: Crossed index and middle fingers (for Unlimited Void)
Gojo.Powers: Infinity barrier, near-unlimited cursed energy, reversed cursed technique
Gojo.Personality: Confident, playful, fiercely protective of his students

Sukuna.Role: King of Curses, sealed inside Yuji Itadori
Sukuna.Hand Sign: Shrine-shaped hand sign used for Malevolent Shrine
Sukuna.Powers: Extreme cursed energy, reversed cursed technique, master swordsman and fighter
Sukuna.Personality: Cruel, arrogant, and bored by weaker opponents

Megumi.Role: First-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High
Megumi.Hand Sign: Shadow hand signs used to summon shikigami (Divine Dog, Nue and others)

Yuji.Cursed Technique: None of his own, uses Divergent Fist and Black Flash
Yuji.Powers: Superhuman strength and speed, Black Flash

Eren.Titan Type: Attack Titan, later the Founding Titan
Eren.Powers: Titan shifting, memory inheritance, command over Subjects of Ymir (Founding Titan)

Armin.Powers: Massive size, steam burst and heat blast

Mikasa.Role: Elite soldier of the Survey Corps
Mikasa.Powers: Ackerman strength, speed and combat skill

Levi.Role: Captain of the Survey Corps Special Operations Squad
Levi.Powers: Humanity's strongest soldier, ODM gear mastery
Levi.Personality: Cold, disciplined, obsessed with cleanliness, deeply loyal

Light.Role: Main protagonist, the killer known as Kira

L.Abilities: Genius deduction, strategic planning, martial arts

Misa.Abilities: Shinigami Eyes (see names and lifespans) through a deal with the shinigami Rem
